run_inference: run inference on a single benchmark system and return energy, forces, and optional performance metrics
compare_results: compare candidate inference predictions against a baseline result and compute energy and force error metrics
format_report_table: format benchmark results dictionary as a human-readable table with energy error, force MAE, and QPS columns
PerfCheckRunner_run: run a benchmark that compares an inference configuration against an fp64 baseline on default test systems
InferenceResult: create an InferenceResult dataclass to store energy, forces, stress, and optional performance metrics from inference
